headline: Asian Shares Fall as Alphabet Earnings Miss Drags Wall Street Futures
summary: Asian equities declined after Alphabet reported earnings that missed expectations, weighing on U.S. stock futures.
why: Alphabet is one of the world's largest technology conglomerates, and its financial performance frequently sets the tone for global market sentiment.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Disappointing earnings from a megacap tech firm weigh on broader tech sector valuations.

why_moved: Weaker-than-expected earnings from Alphabet sparked valuation concerns, lowering U.S. index futures and pressuring Asian stock markets.
